ONE_LINE_DESCRIPTION: Push a local project to GitHub from Windows + China network environment
TRIGGER_3: create a GitHub repo for this
STEP_1_COMMAND:
git config --global http.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
git config --global https.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
STEP_1_WHY: Without proxy config, git push hangs or times out because GitHub is blocked by GFW.
STEP_2_TITLE: Use SSH remote instead of HTTPS
STEP_2_WHY: HTTPS triggers Windows credential manager popups and often returns 403. SSH with key auth goes through the proxy cleanly.
STEP_3_WHY: Git Bash on Windows may misinterpret default branch; explicit `-u origin main` avoids this.
WHY_FAILS_1: GitHub is blocked; connection times out after 60 seconds.
WHY_FAILS_2: Browser OAuth flow fails due to proxy/CORS issues; credential manager popup breaks non-interactive use.
ADDITIONAL_NOTES: If proxy address differs (e.g., v2ray uses 10809), update accordingly. If SSH key not set up: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 then add to GitHub Settings → SSH Keys.
